entries.title: Credit Market Strategies
entries.description: Public and liquid credit investing across traded instruments, focused on relative value, credit selection, and market opportunities.

entries.title: Direct Lending
entries.description: Private credit provided directly to companies (often sponsor-backed or structured), including senior, unitranche, and other bespoke lending solutions.

entries.title: Fundamental Strategies
entries.description: Fundamentally driven investing based on company/asset analysis, underwriting cash flows and downside protection rather than trading signals.

entries.title: Global Opportunities
entries.description: Broad, opportunistic investing across geographies, sectors, and asset types, allowing flexible capital solutions where risk/return is attractive.

entries.title: Growth
entries.description: Investments in growing companies, typically focused on expansion capital, structured equity, or growth-oriented financing solutions.

entries.title: Public Markets
entries.description: Investing and financing in publicly traded securities, often with flexible mandates across credit and/or equity in liquid markets.

entries.title: Real Estate
entries.description: Investments and financing tied to real estate assets and platforms, including property-level and portfolio-level capital solutions.

entries.title: Sports, Media & Entertainment
entries.description: Investments in content, distribution, and media/entertainment businesses, including traditional and digital media platforms.
